name: Mangog

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Energy Resistance: Enerji hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Stagger: Sendeletilen (Staggered) şampiyonlar bir sonraki kazandıkları buff'ı Nullify eder.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Pasif güç kazanımı, durdurulamaz ve engellenemez tehlikeleri var. E2 ölümcül olabilir, onu tüm dövüş boyunca E1'de tutmak şiddetle tavsiye edilir. Petrify veya güç kontrolü olan şampiyon kullan.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mystic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Empowered By Sin
Each time a Stagger expires naturally on the Opponent Mangog has a [10 - 25]% chance to gain +1 Hatred.
While Unstoppable Mangog Passively Regenerates [10 - 20]% of incoming hit damage instantly.
Gain +[117.42 - 340.18] Attack Rating per Hatred.
Gain +[5.52 - 11.04] Critical Damage Rating per Hatred.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Zırh Kırma Bağışıklığı 🛡️
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı (ile sinerji: Odin) 🔮

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Immune to Armor Break Debuffs and all Bleed effects.
Mangog suffers -40% Combat Power Rate, instead gaining 5% of a Power Bar every second while below 2 full Bars.
If struck while Unstoppable, gain a non-stacking Fury Buff granting +[11,341] Attack Rating for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Hatred of a billion billion beings - Max Stacks 10
content: Mangog starts with 3 Hatred. Hatred is unaffected by Ability Accuracy and cannot be gained more than once every 0.2 seconds.
Gain +1 Hatred each time either champion finishes a 5-hit combo.
Gain +1 Hatred when Nullifying a Buff.
Each stack of Hatred grants the following:
+[305.56] Energy Resistance.
+[87.98] Armor Rating.
+[79.22] Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Enraged
content: Activating a Special Attack with 10 stacks of Hatred triggers Enrage, causing Hate to fall off over 8 seconds after the Special Attack ends.
While Enraged, each time Mangog would gain Hate, Enrage is paused for 3 second(s) instead.
Take 50% less damage from enemy attacks and the Recoil Mastery.
Gain an indefinite Unstoppable Buff, this is removed when Enrage expires or if Mangog is struck by a Special Attack.
During Special Attacks 1 and 2 gain an indefinite Unblockable Buff.
Basic Attacks that make contact with the Opponent have a 70% chance to inflict a 14 second Stagger Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Heavy Charging can be held for an extended duration and deals a burst of up to [56,705] Energy Damage based on charge time.
While Enrage is not active, consume 2 Hatred to inflict an Armor Break Debuff for 15 seconds, reducing Armor Rating by [305.56].
While Enraged, gain +220% Ability Power Rate while Charging.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation gain +2 Hatred, this bypasses the gain cooldown.
The second and final hits inflict a Stagger Debuff for 14 seconds.
If Enraged, gain a non-stacking Energy Protection Buff, granting full immunity to Shock, Incinerate, Coldsnap, and Frostbite effects for 15 seconds. This Buff is paused while Enraged.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit deals a burst of [5,103.45] Energy Damage.
The first hit Steals the Opponent's Power above their nearest Full Bar, if they have less then 1 Full Bar of Power, all their Power is stolen. Mangog gains 100% of the Power stolen from this attack.
If Enraged the final hit inflict a Stun Debuff for 3 seconds. If the Opponent is struck the Stun is removed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Nullify up to 10 Buffs from the Opponent.
Gain a non-stacking Regeneration Buff healing +[3,831.43] Base Health over 5 seconds. This is increased by an additional +[3,831.43] Base Health for each Buff that was Nullified during this attack.
If Enraged this attack inflicts a Stun Debuff for 2 seconds.
